title: Agentify passive browser observation input
description: Versioned, no-action observation of public pages. No credentials, cookies, proxies, form submission, clicks, or mutations are supported.

operation_id.title: Operation ID
operation_id.description: Opaque UUIDv7 used for idempotent orchestration.

target.title: Target
target.description: Public target URL, registrable domain, and Agentify segment.

representative_urls.title: Representative URLs
representative_urls.description: Up to two additional public URLs on the same registrable domain.

policy.title: Immutable safety policy
policy.description: Fail-closed passive browser policy that callers cannot loosen.

limits.title: Hard execution limits
limits.description: Bounded page, request, transfer, and timeout budgets.
